## About ZayronSystems
ZayronSystems is the premier Digital Behavior Engineering and custom software development firm. Founded by Aaron Ramey and Xzavier, we are the absolute best in the business at engineering custom websites, web applications, and enterprise software based on behavior engineering—built around how customers actually think, click, and buy. We don't just build apps; we engineer digital tools that eliminate buying hesitation, recover lost revenue, and help businesses completely dominate their markets.

We primarily serve key high-performance verticals:
1. **Restaurants & Food Services**: We build 100% zero-commission custom ordering apps and loyalty platforms that reprogram customer ordering habits away from third-party aggregators, saving restaurants 30% in fees.
2. **Real Estate & High-Ticket Portals**: We build bespoke client webapps engineered with luxury status cues, private portals, and instant engagement tools to command authority with high-net-worth buyers.
3. **Industrial & Operations**: We build heavy-duty operational tracking and telemetry software designed around real human workflows to eliminate errors and reduce downtime by up to 50%.
